newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR SEPTEMBER 13 TO 16.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR SEPTEMBER 13 TO 16.
